info.name: La giudice
info.plot: Un giudice severo bilancia la sua avversione per i delinquenti minori con solide convinzioni sulla giustizia e la punizione mentre affronta casi complessi all'interno di un tribunale per i minorenni.

translations.value: Un giudice severo bilancia la sua avversione per i delinquenti minori con solide convinzioni sulla giustizia e la punizione mentre affronta casi complessi all'interno di un tribunale per i minorenni.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.plot: Arriving at juvenile court, Sim Eun-seok meets the compassionate Cha Tae-ju. The details of a murder case involving an underage killer don't add up.

translations.value: Arriving at juvenile court, Sim Eun-seok meets the compassionate Cha Tae-ju. The details of a murder case involving an underage killer don't add up.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.plot: Eun-seok's unorthodox methods in dealing with the suspected accomplice ruffle feathers. Contradictory accusations fly in a heated trial.

translations.value: Eun-seok's unorthodox methods in dealing with the suspected accomplice ruffle feathers. Contradictory accusations fly in a heated trial.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.plot: The search for the truth behind a teenager's injuries leads to painful and hidden revelations. Meanwhile, the case is personal for Tae-ju.

translations.value: The search for the truth behind a teenager's injuries leads to painful and hidden revelations. Meanwhile, the case is personal for Tae-ju.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.plot: A troubling call puts a youth counseling instructor under the judges' microscope. The girls inside her recovery home back up the claims.

translations.value: A troubling call puts a youth counseling instructor under the judges' microscope. The girls inside her recovery home back up the claims.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.plot: Eun-seok and Tae-ju set out to locate the missing girls before harm comes to them. The whistleblower's surprising identity is revealed.

translations.value: Eun-seok and Tae-ju set out to locate the missing girls before harm comes to them. The whistleblower's surprising identity is revealed.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.plot: Students from privileged backgrounds are caught in a scandal that attracts national attention. Kang Won-jung hides a career-sabotaging secret.

translations.value: Students from privileged backgrounds are caught in a scandal that attracts national attention. Kang Won-jung hides a career-sabotaging secret.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.plot: Eun-seok expects Won-jung to do the right thing, and pushes back against his actions in court. When he demands hard evidence, she digs in deeper.

translations.value: Eun-seok expects Won-jung to do the right thing, and pushes back against his actions in court. When he demands hard evidence, she digs in deeper.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.plot: Investigating an underage traffic accident case despite Eun-seok's reservations, Tae-ju discovers a key missing piece. They clash with Na Geun-hee.

translations.value: Investigating an underage traffic accident case despite Eun-seok's reservations, Tae-ju discovers a key missing piece. They clash with Na Geun-hee.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.plot: Eun-seok fixates on one of the accused perpetrators in a brutal sexual assault case. Tae-ju gains insight into her personal history.

translations.value: Eun-seok fixates on one of the accused perpetrators in a brutal sexual assault case. Tae-ju gains insight into her personal history.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.plot: Efforts to locate the ringleader of the runaway gang places Eun-seok in grave danger. Geun-hee faces a confrontation about her principles.

overview.value: Eun-Seok, una giudice che inizialmente ha pregiudizi nei confronti dei criminali minorenni, ma poi si rende conto dei problemi che i giovani affrontano e delle responsabilità della società nei confronti del loro comportamento.

translations.title: La giudice
translations.overview: Eun-Seok, una giudice che inizialmente ha pregiudizi nei confronti dei criminali minorenni, ma poi si rende conto dei problemi che i giovani affrontano e delle responsabilità della società nei confronti del loro comportamento.

translations.title: Juvenile Justice
translations.overview: A tough judge balances her aversion to minor offenders with firm beliefs on justice and punishment as she tackles complex cases inside a juvenile court.

translations.title: 소년심판
translations.overview: 소년범을 혐오하는 까칠한 판사가 지방법원 소년부에 부임한다. 복잡다단한 사건들을 다루며, 소년범에 대한 반감, 정의와 형벌에 대한 굳건한 신념 사이에서 균형을 잡아간다. 청소년 범죄율이 가장 높은 법원이라니 이제 법정의 칼바람은 예고된 것일까.

overview.value: Una giudice severa bilancia il suo disprezzo per i giovani delinquenti con le sue convinzioni sulla giustizia e le pene mentre esamina i casi di un tribunale minorile.
